commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the Eye of Argonia, the old priest-kings jewel at the Root under Teku-Sul Spire. The Kings Gate needs three seal-stones; I have Blackrose and Gemin, the third is in the vault of Vorannuhl behind a bronze door. Rivals are the Unbound and the Collector Ennodius Vanin. I must not lift the Eye. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door. 3. Pickpocket the key unseen, or kill him and take it (I have paralysis poisons and a sap jar, so a quiet approach is possible); I could also talk to him first. 4. I do not know why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound. I could find out by asking people.
